ModMetaData.name: Faded Catharsis
ModMetaData.author: Vectorial1024
ModMetaData.description:
A very simple patch-mod that significantly nerfs the Catharsis thought: Catharsis now only provides +5 mood instead of +40 mood.
Play like the OGs did! Remember that time when the v0.xx alpha-stage RimWorld doesn't even have this thing called "Catharsis". Mental break death spirals are real!
(Void Catharsis from the Anomaly DLC is unchanged for DLC-lore reasons.)
As a rule of thumb, it is unlikely that this mod will cause any problems with any future RimWorld releases, but do tell me otherwise.
